name: Sarah Martinez
summary: 32-year-old working mom in Austin who values convenience, quality, and family wellbeing. Smartphone-first user who seeks time-saving solutions while maintaining family values. Thorough researcher who balances efficiency with careful decision-making.
quote: I just want to find good products for my family without spending hours researching. Time is more precious than money, but I still need to make smart choices.

demographics.background: Working professional and mom. Active in her community and values work-life balance.

needs.need: Feel confident in decisions that affect her family
Achieve recognition as a capable, organised person
Have autonomy over her schedule and choices

frustrations.frustration: Feeling rushed and time-pressured in daily routines
Anxiety about making wrong decisions with limited information

technology.description: Smartphone-first user. Active on Instagram and Pinterest. Uses apps for shopping, banking, and family organization. Comfortable with online purchases but prefers secure payment methods.

communication.style: Prefers concise, visual communication. Values quick, scannable information over lengthy explanations.
